title: The Night the Stars Asked for Directions
hook: Every north-facing window lights up at once, the quarry reflects a sky no one can see, and a voice from above asks for directions to Cedar Crossing.
truth: The previous anomalies are pieces of a damaged contact-and-return protocol; the Orchard Star Gate is opening at the wrong rural landmark and may pull the town into the visitors' homesick signal.

monster.name: The Orchard Star Gate
monster.instinct: To open a return corridor by anchoring itself to local memory, maps, and witnessed contact events.
weaknesses: a quarry reflection broken at the right moment

countdown.label: Windows Light
countdown.text: Every north-facing window glows with the same patient blue-white light.

countdown.label: Map Erasure
countdown.text: Road maps lose the mile between town and the quarry.

countdown.label: Homesick Voices
countdown.text: The signal speaks in voices of places people miss, not people they know.

countdown.label: Orchard Sky
countdown.text: The Orchard Sink fills with reflected stars and rises like water.

countdown.label: County Panic
countdown.text: Witnesses converge on the quarry with cameras, rifles, blankets, and several casseroles.

countdown.label: Wrong Return
countdown.text: The gate opens through Cedar Crossing instead of above it, offering to take the whole town home.

clues.text: Each previous mystery produced one contact record that needs correction: survey, calendar, courier, language, envoy, and destination.
The quarry water reflects the gate more accurately than the sky does.
The signal calls with longing rather than command, pulling hardest on people thinking of home.
The Polite Visitor's true destination is not Earth but a relay station that used Cedar Crossing as a mistaken label.
Names of places people choose to stay weaken the pull of the gate.
Rippling the quarry reflection at the moment of plain-spoken correction can redirect the gate.

keeperHints: Bring back clues, NPC pressures, and odd details from earlier mysteries.
Keep the finale about contact, correction, and choosing place, not defeating evil invaders.
Let the comedy come from human logistics around wonder: traffic, blankets, forms, and food.
revealPolicy: Reveal the gate as a damaged return protocol assembled from the previous mysteries' evidence.
automationSafety: Do not remove the whole town unless the table clearly wants a catastrophic ending.
Do not declare final contact successful without the group earning corrected records and a clear destination.
